_comment: Minimum tests that must EXECUTE per project. The control for defect class DC-012: a crashed test host reports success with a smaller count, and nothing else notices. Raise these with `python tools/verify-test-run.py --update` when you add tests; never lower one to make a run pass. Keys with a suffix are HALVES of a project run on one OS; `splits` says which halves must account for which whole, and verify-test-run checks that sum on every invocation, on both operating systems. AiDe.Core.Tests.nonportable is [Trait("Platform","Windows")] only - kernel32, powershell.exe, the net10.0-windows daemon, and tests that assert Windows path semantics on purpose. There is no quarantine category: every test that merely failed on Linux was diagnosed and fixed (INV-0005).
_baselineBump: 2026-09-11, node F4 (the composer: R15/R19, Security C9-C21, Privacy C14(e)(i)-(vi)). AiDe.App.Tests 456 -> 493 (37 new: the host-owned send seam, the page policy, the no-late-binding window, the rendered field-level errors and template picker, and the real-WebView2 composer probe). AiDe.Core.Tests 2064 -> 2199, portable 1912 -> 2046, non-portable 152 -> 153. The single new Windows-traited case is C14(e)(ii)'s directory-junction-in-the-prefix row; its sibling leaf-link row is portable and exercises a symlink on Linux and a junction on Windows, because Windows refuses CreateSymbolicLink without a privilege a developer machine does not have by default. MEASURED ON THIS TREE, all four keys: 2046 + 153 = 2199 and all three Core runs were executed, so the split invariant holds by OBSERVATION. AiDe.App.Tests was run under the PowerShell console host, per DC-117. verify-test-run.py --update was NEVER run. Every floor raised; none lowered.
